{{undubbed}} {{EpicodePrevNext| prevcode=PT09 | prevtitle=| nextcode=PT11 | nexttitle= | series=POKÉTOON | colorscheme=Paldea}} {{EpisodeInfobox| epcode=PT10 | colorscheme=Paldea | title_en=| title_ja=怒りのオコリザル観察日記 | title_ja_trans=Angry Okorizaru Observation Report | release_method=Web release | screen=hd | broadcast_jp=September 25, 2024 | broadcast_us= | en_op=N/A | ja_op=None | ja_ed=[[THAT'S IT!!!|そうです!!!]] | olmteam= | scenario= | storyboard= | director= | art= | morecredits=no | epstaffpage=PT09-PT16 | footnotes=* {{BMGf|303414|Review thread on BMGf}} * [https://youtu.be/LvlwKAv15XU 怒りのオコリザル観察日記] on the official Japanese [[YouTube]] channel }} (Japanese: '''怒りのオコリザル観察日記''' ''Angry {{tt|Okorizaru|Primeape}} Observation Report'') is the second episode of the second season of [[POKÉTOON]] and tenth overall. It was first released in Japan on the official Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel on September 25, 2024. English subtitles were added to the video on October 3, 2024. ==Blurb== ==Plot== A {{OBP|boy|PT10}} is presenting a report to his classroom, where he decided to observe his friend {{p|Primeape}} over the summer. Primeape is a Pokémon that's always angry, so the boy wants to see what Primeape looks like when its not angry. He observes Primeape playing the backyard, but Primeape's stomach growls with hunger. It tries to climb a tree and pick a berry, but an {{p|Aipom}} gets the berry first. The boy brings over some berries for Primeape, but ends up overfeeding it, and making it even angrier. Next, he tries to give the Primeape a bath, a relaxing massage, and beauty products for its fur, but seeing its hair styled makes Primeapre angry again. The boy then tries to click photos of Primeape with various props, including cute, shiny, and fun things, but Primeape is still angry. The boy and Primeape visit a field where Psyduck, Quagsire, and Slowpoke are lying in peace, but this confuses the Primeape, causing it jump into a lake. The boy then tries various other things, like picnicking, stargazing, hiking, sunbathing, skiing, ziplining, watching a movie, visiting hot springs, and attending a concert, but Primeape remains angry. On the way back from one event, Primeape angrily knocks out a tub of popcorn from the boy's hand with {{m|Rage Fist}}, which leads the boy to realize that Primeape wants to become stronger. The boy and Primeape battle a trainer and his {{p|Houndour}}, defeating them easily. They continue battling more and more trainers and keep winning, eventually going all the way to a Pokémon League Champion battle against a {{p|Baxcalibur}}. While it looks like they might be about to lose, the boy reassures his Primeape, and Primeape it able to defeat the Baxcalibur. Having too much rage, Primeape unexpectedly evolves into {{p|Annihilape}}. The boy ends his report by saying that Primeape was angry until the last moment. Howver, he won't give up, and his next report will be on Annihilape. While the rest of the students are unsure of how to react to the report, they notice Annihilape outside the classroom window, and scream in terror at the scary-looking Pokémon. ==Major events== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * [[Boy (PT10)|Boy]] * Kids * {{tc|Hiker}} (poster) * Movie audience * [[Lisia]] * Concert audience * {{tc|Student}}s * Kid Boss * {{tc|Bug Catcher}} * {{tc|Hiker}} * {{tc|Lass}} * {{tc|Swimmer}} * {{tc|Musician}} * {{tc|Model}} * Battle audience * {{tc|Teacher}} ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Primeape}} ([[Boy (PT10)|Boy]]'s;
